scope: Independent arithmetic review of retained official results only; no measurement, test, build, replay, worker or game executed.

method.implementation: Independent Python standard-library calculation; no official comparator or review module imported or executed.
method.globalValues: Every trial with warmup false, replayElapsedMs; four sessions per case/version/cohort, pooled before median.
method.globalFormula: median(candidate sessions) / median(baseline sessions) - 1; strictly less than 0.1 separately per case.
method.phaseValues: session_elapsed uses replayElapsedMs; known_prefix_service/request use nativeServiceMs/wallMs from requests with type advance and kind action; other stages use matching samples[].elapsedMs.
method.phaseClassification: Historical <= 0.1 median rule; noisy/unresolved classification retained above the threshold when either per-session median relative range exceeds 0.1. Noise adds no allowance.
method.p95: Empirical nearest rank ceil(0.95*n), withheld below 20 samples; independently recalculated from all raw samples.
method.numericComparison: Absolute and relative float tolerance 1e-12 for comparing arithmetic receipts only. The strict global budget threshold itself is not adjusted.
method.exclusions: Only eight declared warmups. No measured sample or outlier excluded; exact ledger multiplicities checked against both aggregate and decision.

conclusions: Global acceptance is reproduced for both cases from all 32 measured sessions: STCK +1.6549587880958727%, SMLP +6.641216545123019%.
Aggregate diagnostics remain 12/16 with STCK known_prefix_service, known_prefix_request and known_prefix_guard, plus SMLP known_prefix_guard, above the historical phase threshold.
Cohort 1 remains 10/16; cohort 2 remains 13/16. SMLP global cohort diagnostics differ: +8.806147793509411% versus +0.37331072297599466%. Both are fully retained, without selecting a cohort.
Largest aggregate p95 increases: STCK restoration +26.77102611404627% and known_prefix_service +26.13464076682035%. Cohort 1 SMLP restoration has a larger separate p95 increase, +65.75969083393525%.
Approximately 1e-16 differences between mathematically equivalent global ratio formulas are floating-point roundoff and affect neither decision nor retained data.
qualification: This lightweight review does not replace the retained 231-check consolidation review, prove hardware-independent speed, identify causal costs, establish tail confidence intervals, or demonstrate FramedWindow contribution in a public game. Nested phases are not summed, cohort ratios are not averaged and one game does not compensate another. Results and seven official tools are unchanged.
